name: 5-Man Overload Edge Fire Zone
formation: Overload 5-Up Wide-9 Front vs 11P Gun 3x1 Deep Shot

summary.motive: Overload the field side of the pass protection with a 5-man fire zone blitz, creating an unblocked perimeter rusher while dropping the boundary defensive end into coverage.
summary.keyDefender: NICKEL (unblocked overload blitzer) & WDE (boundary flat dropper)
summary.whyItWorks: Offensive slide protections cannot account for both the interior looping linebacker and the perimeter slot DB, ensuring a free rusher to the quarterback.
summary.failureMode: A quick screen to the boundary side if the dropping defensive end fails to get sufficient width to make the tackle.

beats.title: Wide-9 Overload Presentation
beats.text: DeMeco Ryans aligns 5 defenders threatening the field side of the formation, creating a numbers overload against the offensive pass protection.

beats.title: Overload Rush Fires; WDE Drops to Flat
beats.text: At the snap, SDE pins the RT inside with a B-gap stunt while WILL attacks the A-gap. Backside WDE bails into the boundary flat to maintain a 3-under 3-deep zone.

beats.title: Pass Protection Overwhelmed on Field Edge
beats.text: The running back steps up to pick WILL’s blitz, leaving NICKEL completely unblocked to scream off the field perimeter.

beats.title: Strip-Sack Fumble Forced
beats.text: NICKEL levels the quarterback from the blind side just as he prepares to throw, knocking the football free for a game-changing turnover.

relations.tell: Field-side overload pressure with SDE slanting inside to clear the edge for Nickel DB while boundary DE drops into coverage
